bio.text: Tessa Lynn Hodge is the Democratic candidate for California's 23rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the June 2 top-two primary.

According to her campaign website, she is a lifelong resident of the High Desert and District 23 and a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with almost a decade of experience working with children in foster care and students in school districts.
The site also says she has worked for San Bernardino County incorporating state and federal legislation into county policy and guidelines.
